summary: Follower tokens shield their Personality from Ranged/Melee Attacks like Follower cards (Mendon's ruling); Items, Spells and Weapon/Armor tokens still only count as attachments for 'without attachments' effects. IsFollowedPersonality counts Follower tokens; NoAttachmentsFilter pins the ruling. Shared because the change is rules code plus a test and a decision doc; no UI or wire change.
